name: talqava-editor
description: The workspace's page editor (Tiptap, MIT), bundled once into public/vendor/editor.js. Only that file ships with the app.

scripts.build: esbuild src/editor.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=chrome120 "--banner:js=/*! Talqava page editor. Bundles Tiptap, ProseMirror and other open-source components; their licences are in editor.LICENSES.txt next to this file. */" --outfile=../public/vendor/editor.js && node ../scripts/licenses.mjs
